Item.Name: S_PHY_ID
Item.Hint: Enter physician ID or use LISTVAL. Enter partial last name to search.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
nullchk;
check_package_failure;
if :control_block.s_phy_id != 'NEW' then
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from physician_list
 where phy_id = :control_block.s_phy_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then show_error('14124'); check_package_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if ;

Item.Name: SPECIALTY_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter specialty code or select from LISTVAL.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :specialty_code is not null then
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'PHYSP'
 and code = :specialty_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then show_error('14401');check_package_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ;check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if ;

Item.Name: ZIP_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter zip code or select from LISTVAL.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :zip_code is not null then
 begin
 select city ,state,usps_id 
 into :city,:state,:usps_id
 from valid_city_state 
 where zip = :zip_code;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 SHOW_ERROR('10002');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE; 
 when too_many_rows then 
 if :system.record_status != 'QUERY'
 then
 declare
 val_selected boolean ;
 begin
 val_selected := show_lov('CITY_LOV');
 if not val_selected then 
 show_error('13014'); check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 end ;
 end if;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
end if ;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.block_status = 'NEW' then
 if :control_block.s_phy_id != 'NEW' then
 execute_query;
 end if ;
end if ;

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 new_id varchar2(10) ;
 err_flag varchar2(1) ;
 err_msg varchar2(70) ;
begin
 create_ids('PHY',new_id);
 :physician_list.phy_id := new_id ;
 :physician_list.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id ;
 :physician_list.program_id := 'SDWPHYSC' ;
 :physician_list.eff_date := trunc(sysdate);
end ;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 select city, state, zip 
 into :city, :state, :zip_code
 from valid_city_state
 where usps_id = :physician_list.usps_id;
exception
 when others then
 null;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CITY_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select city, state, zip, usps_id from valid_city_state where zip = :physician_list.zip_code

RecordGroup.Name: PHY_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select phy_id,last_name||', '||first_name||' '||mi phy_name from physician_list where (phy_id=:s_phy_id or last_name like '%'||:s_phy_id||'%') and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id order by last_name

RecordGroup.Name: RG_ZIP
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select zip,city,state, usps_id from valid_city_state where zip = :addresses.zip order by city,state

RecordGroup.Name: PHYSP_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select code,description from valid_master_codes where code_type='PHYSP' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
